requirements.message: this overlay requires an IconClickFallbackImage at most 20 pixels tall. Missing IconClickFallbackImage or height fails closed. Joins sibling min IconClickFallbackImage size and sibling max_icon_click_fallback_width on one IconClickFallbackImage. Distinct from min_icon_click_fallback_height. Builtin packs do not pin an IconClickFallbackImage height cap.
